_about: The repository files each sharded suite reads. A pull request runs runner-tests or glaeda-gh-tests only when it changes one of that suite's files, or a path outside scripts/ and config/ that is not Markdown or another workflow. Read from strace -f of every shard (the files they open, exec or stat), plus what scripts/test-ci-job-inputs.py asks: each listed module's imports and the test file's own scripts/ and config/ paths. Pushes to main run both suites whole.
